symptom: CatalogSchemaVersion said "15" while its history comment documented a "16"; caches built at 15 by one of two parallel branches never rebuilt for the other branch's change
cause: c449e1c2b (permissions DefaultMemberAccessRights) and 11ff6f204 (refs member/enumeration targets) each bumped 14 -> 15; the merge relabelled one history entry 16 but kept the constant at 15
insight: A parallel bump collides silently because both sides write the same line. When merging two catalog changes, check the constant is above every history entry; 17 now carries both
